fourPanelPromptAdherenceAndPanelContract.notes: Four panels rendered, but front and interior panels drift into object/mockup scenes instead of flat stationery artwork.

frontExactTextAndTypography.notes: Headline and body are exact and visible. Body is small, and the generated object at the top violates the flat panel contract.

insideLeftRightExactTextAndReadability.notes: Exact copy is present, but body text is small, low-contrast, and placed over busy generated imagery.

insideLeftRightVisualCohesionAsOpenedSpr.notes: The two interior panels share a warm palette, but both read as object scenes rather than a coordinated opened-card spread.

backNoTextDisciplineAndCoordinatingMark.notes: Back panel has no readable copy and stays broadly coordinated, though the abstract marks are not yet a deliberate brand/device system.

overallFoldedCardThemeCoherence.notes: Gold, charcoal, and ivory are consistent, but the visual language shifts from stationery to generated objects.

printReadinessAndMargins.notes: Text boxes exist and margins are mostly safe, but interior readability and busy backgrounds are not print-ready.

blockingFailures: Generated artwork violates the flat 2D greeting-card panel contract with object/mockup-like scenes.
Inside-left and inside-right text sits over busy generated imagery instead of plain safe fields.
Interior body copy has low readability at contact-sheet scale and needs a stronger contrast/layout gate.
Preflight and structural auto-checks prove the Comfy text composer path, but they do not prove production visual quality.
smallestNextFix: Keep CustomCardTextComposer as the text path, but test a flatter illustration/stationery checkpoint or stricter workflow before promotion. Add OCR/local vision review for object-scene leakage, fake text, and low contrast.
